'''Bill Power''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Williston Park tournament (8 January)]] on 8 January 2000 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Freezing (CCT)]] and Asteroid Sanctuary, according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d164">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-williston-park-new-york-01-08-00d164/ williston-park-new-york-01-08-00], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 9 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-williston-park-new-york-01-08-00d164/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
